newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine police and squatters clash, 23 injured.
newsitem.headline: Philippine police and squatters clash, 23 injured.

text.p: Scores of Philippine squatters hurled petrol bombs, rocks and darts on Tuesday to thwart attempts by police and demolition crews to tear down their shanties in central Manila, witnesses said.

At least three policemen were injured, police said. Doctors at a city hospital said 20 squatters, some of them infants, were treated after inhaling teargas police had lobbed in a bid to disperse the mob.
But police and demolition teams were forced to retreat after gusts of wind blew the gas back into their faces, and witnesses said no huts were demolished.
City authorities ordered the demolition of the shanties after the owners of the private lot the squatters were occupying said they would turn it into a commercial area.

Tens of thousands of families live in squatter colonies around the capital. The government has for years been trying to demolish their shanties, saying it plans to convert the land they occupy into industrial zones.
